chunks: Jaʿfar ibn al-Qāsim narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, who said:
"Indeed, at the top of every bridge there is a devil; so when you reach it, say: 'In the Name of Allah,' and it will depart from you."

key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ: in the Name of Allah; a formula of dhikr and seeking refuge

ai.seo_question: What should be said when crossing a bridge according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches seeking protection through dhikr when encountering places of vulnerability or fear. It instructs the believer to say "In the Name of Allah" upon reaching a bridge, by which the shaytan departs.
